mapper.sql: t.id, t.slug, t.name, t.description, t.status, t.created_at, t.updated_at

where.if: AND (LOWER(t.name) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR LOWER(t.slug) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sr_blog_topic (slug, name, description, status) VALUES (#{slug}, #{name}, #{description}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sr_blog_topic t WHERE t.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM sr_blog_topic t WHERE t.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sr_blog_topic WHERE slug = #{slug}
AND id <> #{excludeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE sr_blog_topic SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT , COUNT(tp.id) AS member_count FROM sr_blog_topic t LEFT JOIN sr_blog_topic_post tp ON tp.topic_id = t.id
GROUP BY t.id, t.slug, t.name, t.description, t.status, t.created_at, t.updated_at ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT t.id, t.slug, t.name, t.description, t.status, COUNT(p.id) AS member_count FROM sr_blog_topic t LEFT JOIN sr_blog_topic_post tp ON tp.topic_id = t.id LEFT JOIN sr_blog_post p ON p.id = tp.post_id AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' WHERE t.status = 'ENABLED' GROUP BY t.id, t.slug, t.name, t.description, t.status ORDER BY t.id

SELECT t.id, t.slug, t.name, t.description, t.status, COUNT(p.id) AS member_count FROM sr_blog_topic t LEFT JOIN sr_blog_topic_post tp ON tp.topic_id = t.id LEFT JOIN sr_blog_post p ON p.id = tp.post_id AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' WHERE t.status = 'ENABLED' AND t.slug = #{slug} GROUP BY t.id, t.slug, t.name, t.description, t.status

SELECT t.id, t.slug, t.name, t.description, t.status FROM sr_blog_topic_post tp JOIN sr_blog_topic t ON t.id = tp.topic_id WHERE tp.post_id = #{postId} AND t.status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY tp.sort_order ASC, t.id ASC
SELECT t.id, t.slug, t.name, t.description, t.status FROM sr_blog_topic_post tp JOIN sr_blog_topic t ON t.id = tp.topic_id WHERE tp.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY tp.sort_order ASC, t.id ASC

SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.slug AS slug, p.title AS title, p.status AS status, tp.sort_order AS sort_order, p.published_at AS published_at, p.updated_at AS updated_at FROM sr_blog_topic_post tp JOIN sr_blog_post p ON p.id = tp.post_id WHERE tp.topic_id = #{topicId} ORDER BY tp.sort_order ASC, tp.id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sr_blog_topic_post WHERE topic_id = #{topicId}
SELECT MAX(sort_order) FROM sr_blog_topic_post WHERE topic_id = #{topicId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sr_blog_topic_post (topic_id, post_id, sort_order) VALUES (#{topicId}, #{postId}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sr_blog_topic_post WHERE topic_id = #{topicId} AND post_id = #{postId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sr_blog_topic_post WHERE topic_id = #{topicId} AND post_id = #{postId}
